Elaine: Heads-up — ran a quick screen-reader sweep of the Console and found three small but blocking things for keyboard/sr users: toasts not announced, breadcrumb links missing ARIA for current page, and the new compact focus style is nearly invisible on dark cards. Screenshot + notes: https://img.redwood.test/console-sr-sweep-03.png Jon: thanks for doing this! can you paste repro steps? which screen reader + browser? Elaine: NVDA + Firefox 115 on Windows 11 for the most part. Steps: 1) trigger a saved-query toast (run a query) 2) navigate to top breadcrumb via keyboard 3) tab through the card actions and notice thin focus. Observed behavior: toast appears visually but NVDA does not announce it; breadcrumb uses plain links without aria-current; focus outline is 1px light gray on a #0f172a card so it disappears. Ana: ugh okay. On the toast — are we using role="alert" or aria-live? We intentionally avoided alert to prevent top-level noise for streaming logs, but toasts for discrete success/errors should be announced. Sam (Eng): current toast code just injects a div into #toasts with role="status" and an aria-hidden attr toggled for animations. i think the aria-hidden logic might be wrong (we set aria-hidden while animating in, so SR misses it). i'll paste the snippet: ```
Saved query • Undo
// after animation div.removeAttribute('aria-hidden') ``` Sam (Eng): PR fix idea — set aria-hidden=false immediately and rely on CSS animation only. or use aria-live="polite" + aria-atomic="true". also ensure the message text does not include purely visual icons that SR ignores. Elaine: +1 on aria-live politeness. also make sure each toast has an id and append a visually-hidden live region fallback for older combos. sample markup I tested that worked: ```
Saved query successful
Saved query • Undo
``` Jon: for breadcrumbs — simple fix is aria-current="page" on the active crumb. anything else needed? screen-reader reads it as a link but doesn't announce it's the current item. Ana: i can update the visual to also bold the active crumb and add a subtle underline on keyboard focus so sighted keyboard users get a stronger cue. but we need to keep the compact layout intact. Maria (PM): timeline? this feels medium priority: affects new Console users and could be regression risk for accessibility audit. Sam, can this be in the next patch (tomorrow's minor)? Sam (Eng): yes for the toast aria change + breadcrumb aria-current i can ship as a hotfix. the focus-outline cosmetic needs design ok from Ana — but I can bump outline width and color in the same patch if Ana signs off. Ana: proposing this CSS for compact focus on cards: ``` .card:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.9); /* indigo-600 @ 90% */ outline-offset: 2px; } ``` Ana: contrast check: indigo-600 has decent contrast against #0f172a, and 3px outline should be visible without changing card geometry. Sam (Eng): looks good. i'll add a11y unit tests: ensure toast appears in live region, breadcrumb has aria-current, and tab order on the card is preserved. a11y-bot: Automated check results (baseline vs branch): - toast-live-region: FAIL (aria-hidden true at insert) - breadcrumb-current: MISSING on last crumb - focus-contrast: WARN (outline exists but < 3px or low contrast in some themes) a11y-bot: Suggested fixes: set aria-live="polite" + aria-atomic="true"; add aria-current="page" to active breadcrumb; ensure focus outline >=3px or use visible box-shadow fallback. Elaine: thanks all. @Sam please ping when PR is up and include the NVDA+VoiceOver smoke tests. @Ana, if you can drop the visual spec in Figma I will run a quick SR pass after deploy. Sam (Eng): will do. I'm opening PR now: https://git.redwood/console/pull/4123 (wip) Ana: Figma link with updated focus + breadcrumb styles: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/console-focus-updates Maria (PM): great — once merged please cherry-pick to the release branch. prioritize the toast announcement fix. Elaine: awesome team, appreciate the quick turnaround :party_parrot: Jon: thanks Elaine for catching this. we'll mark it as a11y-hotfix in the release notes.
